hits.name: Tan Suede Penny Loafer
hits.description: Cognac-tan suede penny loafer. Clean silhouette, rubber sole.
hits.imagePrompt: Tan suede penny loafer with leather sole, structured toe box, brass hardware slot, polished finish.

hits.name: Tan Leather Chelsea Boot
hits.description: Natural tan leather Chelsea boot. Versatile enough for rooftop or office.

hits.name: Tan Block-Heel Sandal
hits.description: Strappy ankle-strap sandal in tan. Block heel keeps it comfortable for a long evening.
hits.imagePrompt: Tan leather block-heel sandal with thin strappy upper and adjustable ankle strap, flat lay on white background

hits.name: Ivory Kitten-Heel Slingback
hits.description: Cream leather kitten-heel slingback. Understated and elegant.
hits.imagePrompt: Ivory pointed-toe slingback with delicate kitten heel, sleek minimalist silhouette, glossy leather finish.

hits.name: Cognac Pointed-Toe Flat
hits.description: Pointed-toe ballet flat in cognac leather.
hits.imagePrompt: Cognac leather pointed-toe ballet flat with sleek minimalist silhouette and soft suede interior.

hits.name: Caramel Cap-Toe Oxford
hits.description: Clean cap-toe oxford in caramel leather.
hits.imagePrompt: Caramel leather oxford with structured cap-toe, polished finish, clean stitching, unisex fit.

hits.name: Dark Brown Leather Chelsea Boot
hits.description: Dark brown leather Chelsea boot. Richer and more evening-ready than tan — pairs with charcoal, navy or forest.
hits.imagePrompt: Dark brown leather Chelsea boot with elastic side gussets, stacked heel, sleek silhouette, polished finish.

hits.name: Black Suede Tassel Loafer
hits.description: Black suede tassel loafer. A classic evening shoe — works with charcoal or dark navy trousers.
hits.imagePrompt: Black suede loafer with brass tassel detail, structured leather sole, relaxed slip-on silhouette.

hits.name: Espresso Leather Derby
hits.description: Full-brogue derby in espresso leather. Deep, rich brown — versatile across dark palettes.
hits.imagePrompt: Dark brown leather derby shoe with burnished finish, structured toe box, visible stitching detail, glossy patina.

hits.name: Strappy Heeled Sandal — Nude
hits.description: Strappy heeled sandal in nude. Thin ankle strap with a slender mid-heel — the warm evening shoe.
hits.imagePrompt: Nude leather strappy heeled sandal for women, thin ankle strap, slender 7cm heel, minimalist open-toe silhouette, flat lay.

hits.name: Ankle Boot — Black Suede
hits.description: Black suede ankle boot with a low block heel. Goes with wide-leg trousers or slim jeans — great for a cooler evening.
hits.imagePrompt: Black suede ankle boot for women, low block heel, round toe, side zip, slightly slouchy upper, flat lay.

hits.name: Pointed Mule — Camel
hits.description: Pointed-toe mule in camel leather. Minimal slip-on silhouette — pairs with trousers or wide-leg jeans.
hits.imagePrompt: Camel leather pointed-toe mule, open back, low kitten heel, structured smooth leather upper, clean minimal silhouette.

hits.name: Classic Canvas Low-Top Sneaker
hits.description: Classic black canvas low-top sneaker with a timeless silhouette that pairs seamlessly with everything from jeans to chinos. Durable vulcanized rubber sole keeps you comfortable whether you're heading out for dinner or casual weekend plans.
hits.imagePrompt: Low-top men's canvas sneaker in black, minimalist design, sleek silhouette, ideal for date night sophistication.

hits.name: Leather Retro Court Sneaker
hits.description: Leather Retro Court Sneaker in white features a classic court-style silhouette with a premium leather upper that works for both casual wear and dressed-up occasions. Clean lines and a timeless design make this a versatile staple that pairs with everything from jeans to chinos.
hits.imagePrompt: Court-style men's leather sneaker in white, refined retro silhouette, timeless date night aesthetic, polished upper.

hits.name: Suede High-Top Sneaker
hits.description: Navy suede high-top sneaker with a soft, velvety finish that elevates casual wear into date-night territory. The structured ankle support and premium material make it a sophisticated alternative to standard canvas.
hits.imagePrompt: High-top men's sneaker in navy suede, sophisticated silhouette, date night ready, premium craftsmanship, sleek ankle collar.

hits.name: Classic Low Top White
hits.description: This classic low top in white is a timeless canvas sneaker with a reinforced toe cap that outlasts everyday wear. Lightweight and versatile, it pairs with virtually any casual outfit.
hits.imagePrompt: Low-top canvas sneaker in white cotton, classic rubber toe cap, clean minimalist design, iconic ankle patch detail.
